We need to get the list of all airports. Then find the first and last airports in that list. Then get the flight cost for travel_from=first airport, travel_to=last airport, travel_date=2026-10-31, travel_class=business. Then we need to provide the estimated total payable amount. That likely includes the flight cost plus maybe taxes? But the function get_flight_cost returns the cost in USD. So we can just give that as the total payable amount.

Thus we need to call get_all_airports. Then parse the result to get the first and last airport codes. Then call get_flight_cost with those parameters. Then respond with the cost.

We need to use the function get_all_airports.
